text:
Aiden: Quick sync  prospect (regional hospital) requested an on-prem sealed-network POC. They asked about delivery (couriered USB vs approved jumpbox pull), upgrade cadence, SBOM/key provenance, and uplift. Need short answers by COB.

Rosa: They prefer couriered media for initial seed, then signed minibundles via an internal staging host. CVE SLA asked: 30 days critical.

Clive: We can support encrypted USB + signed manifest. Full bundle ~11GB compressed; minibundles <200MB. For strict transfer limits we shard into 500MB parts and provide sha256 manifest + reassembly helper.

Natasha: Cadence rec: monthly security minibundles, quarterly feature rollups. Emergency hotfix path (48-72h) available as paid add-on.

Legal: Suggested wording for questionnaire: "We provide a redacted SBOM and signer certificate chain. Signing is performed inside FIPS 140-2/3 HSMs; private keys never leave the HSM. HSM attestation and redacted audit logs can be provided under NDA."

Aiden: Ops ask: include offline license activation tokens & CLI import steps in the runbook. Also add chunk verification commands the customer can run offline.

PackagerBot: Sample verification snippet we can share:
```
# verify chunks -> verify signature -> reassemble
sha256sum part_* > parts.sha256
redwood-sign verify --manifest parts.sha256 --cert signer.crt
cat part_* > bundle.tar.gz && tar -tzf bundle.tar.gz
```

Clive: On engineering effort: minibundle + signing automation ~2 business days; full offline runbook, chunker tests, and PS packaging ~6 business days. No canned SKU for chunking  bill as PS (estimate 10 16 hours).

Natasha: Commercials: one-time packaging & signing fee + concierge-staging uplift (~15%) for first quarter. Emergency channel modeled as monthly premium.

Aiden: Plan: Rosa to confirm media preference with customer; Clive to produce sanitized SBOM + runbook; Legal to finalize questionnaire answers; PackagerBot to prepare sample manifests. Reply to customer by EOD tomorrow.

Rosa: Compliance: they need SBOM sample within 48 hours for procurement signoff. No other blockers.

Legal: Reminder: redact audit logs and never post private key material in channel.

Aiden: Thanks team. I'll assemble and send.
